Introduction

JO1 is an eleven-member Japanese boy group under LAPONE Entertainment. They were formed through the survival show Produce 101 Japan, and consists of Sho, Ren, Ruki, Junki, Keigo, Takumi, Syoya, Shosei, Sky, Shion, and Mame. They debuted on March 4, 2020, with the single "Protostar".

The "J" in JO1 refers to Japan, the group's origin, while the "01" represents the first year of the Reiwa period, during which the group was formed. Their fans are called "JAM", short for "JO1 and Me", symbolizing the bond between JO1 and their supporters. In addition to Japan, the group also promote their music in South Korea and appears on several Korean music shows.
